dedupe_keys.name: datos de fractura de pozos de hidrocarburos adjunto iv

description: Datos de fractura de pozos de hidrocarburos (Adjunto IV) is a dataset listed in Argentine national open data portal (datos.gob.ar), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Energía. Detalle por pozo, formación, tipo de reservorio, yacimiento, concesión y provincia de: longitud de rama horizontal (m), cantidad de etapas de fractura, tipo de terminación, toneladas de arena bombeada nacional e importada (t), agua inyectada (m3), CO2 inyectado (m3), presión máxima (psi), potencia de equipos de fractura (hp), fechas de inicio y fin de fractura ... Coverage: Argentina. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Energía. Its tags are Capítulo IV, Gas, Hidrocarburos, Petróleo, Pozos. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, PDF. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ar-portal.
